class Student:
    def __init__(self):
        self._mentor = None

    def getMentor(self):
        return self._mentor

    def hasMentor(self):
        return self._mentor is not None

    def setMentor(self, aNewMentor):
        if aNewMentor is None:
            existingMentor = self._mentor
            self._mentor = None
            if existingMentor is not None and existingMentor.getStudent() is not None:
                existingMentor.setStudent(None)
            return True
        currentMentor = self._mentor
        if currentMentor is not None and currentMentor is not aNewMentor:
            currentMentor.setStudent(None)
        self._mentor = aNewMentor
        existingStudent = aNewMentor.getStudent()
        if existingStudent is not self:
            aNewMentor.setStudent(self)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        if self._mentor is not None:
            self._mentor.setStudent(None)
